title: Love numbers for a multistratified model

source.citation: Spada, G. et al. (2011). Geophysical Journal International 185(1), 106-132.

what_to_compute: As test 5/1, for the 28-layer model VSS96 instead of M3-L70-V01. The many layers make the root-finding of the normal mode method hard, which is the point of the test.

reference_data.$comment: Contributor abbreviations are those of the paper's table 1. For a converted test, the files read and what each column holds are in the `files` table of gia_mip/resources/spada_column_layouts.json. `not_converted` gives, per contributor, the reason its data is not in the converted file.

not_converted.GS: Table 1 of the paper lists GS, but figure 7 shows only Vk, Gsa and Rr, and the archive holds no GS result for VSS96. The lines of T01-06/love_PAP.gmt that read GS's files are commented out, and the files whose banner comments name GS are VK's (correction spada-t01-06-banner-names-gs-for-vk-files).

reference_data.reference_status: closed on 2026-09-15 by Sia Ghelichkhani: the archive spada2011-cost-es0701 is the reference data for this test, and what it lacks is recorded in not_converted and status. New data for a gap is added as a new original, with its own provenance and corrections.

status: converted: GSA, RR and VK in data/converted/spada2011/spada2011-t01-06.nc, for the degrees figure 7 draws: 2 to 9, 12 to 96 at 12, and 128 to 254 at 18. VK's curves start at the second or third time of VK's run (correction spada-vk-first-rows-read-as-header). No GS data exists for this test.
